title: GPT-4 agents guide chemical synthesis development and purification
summary: The November 2024 Nature Communications paper describes six GPT-4 agents guiding copper/TEMPO alcohol oxidation, from literature search through optimization and purification. An agent-assisted scale-up produced 915 mg of product at 86% isolated yield and above 98% purity. Additional reaction tasks were demonstrated. The workflow involved chemists: thin-layer chromatography was performed manually, so this was not fully autonomous synthesis.
organization: Zhejiang University; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Suzhou Novartis Technical Development Co. Ltd.; Rezubio Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd.

evidence.tested: Physical synthesis, optimization, scale-up and product purification.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: supplements; manual TLC and chemist participation are explicit in the paper.
evidence.ai_role: Six GPT-4 agents supported literature, design, execution, analysis, separation and interpretation.
